t: 728 L E Hoover illicit imporation of arms

pages.en:
B.728
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
HEADQUARTERS
CENTRAL REGISTRY.
C.I.D. No. B.728.
24: 12 : 25.

December 24, 25.

Dear Hilton-Johnson,

Reference to your
enquiries re L. E. Hoover, rumours have
been current from time to time to the
effect that he has been engaged in the
illicit importation of arms, but as yet
no evidence has been obtained by the
Police in confirmation thereof. I return
the file herewith as requested.

Yours sincerely,

〔此处转录不清〕

Major A. Hilton-Johnson,
Commissioner General,
S. M. P.
pages.zh:
B.728
上海公共租界工部局警务处
总部
中央档案室。
刑事侦缉处档案号 B.728。
24: 12 : 25。

1925年12月24日。

亲爱的希尔顿-约翰逊：

关于你查询 L. E. 胡佛（Hoover）一事，不时有谣言流传，称其从事武器非法进口活动，但警方迄今尚未获得确证。现按你的要求将卷宗退回。

此致

敬礼

〔此处转录不清〕

A. 希尔顿-约翰逊少校，
总巡捕，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

TEL. NO. C. 743
（印：DIRECTOR OF CRIMINAL INTELLIGENCE ★ 刑事偵緝處長）
Memorandum
Shanghai Municipal Police
December 24th 192 5.
To Acting Commissioner of Police.
Sir,
C. I. D. File No. B728 referring
to the disappearance of a Thompson Automatic
Rifle is attached.
Rumours have been current from
time to time to the effect that Hoover has
been engaged in the illicit importation of
arms but no evidence in confirmation thereof
has, as yet, been obtained by the Police.
〔此处转录不清〕
D. C. I.

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.
COMMISSIONER-GENERAL'S OFFICE.

C.G.O.172/2                                          Dec. 22, 1925.

Personal

Capt. E. I. M. Barrett,
      Acting Commissioner of Police,
                        Shanghai.

      Herewith a note from Mr. Nicholson, whom I know, in
re the activities of one Hoover, known to you. Can you
please let me have any information available in regard to
this man? Please return file.

                              A. Hollon Johnson
                  Commissioner General.
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局。
总办处。

C.G.O.172/2                                          1925年12月22日。

私人

E. I. M. 巴雷特上尉，
      代理警务处长，
                        上海。

      随函附上我认识的尼科尔森（Nicholson）先生的一张便条，关于你所知悉的胡佛（Hoover）一人的活动。能否请你提供有关此人的任何现有信息？请退回卷宗。

                              A. 霍伦·约翰逊
                  总办
